blocks.text: 🪝 PFRDA Launches 'StAR NPS' Digital Onboarding Framework Developed by BSE Technologies. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Streamlines digital account opening with ₹200 registration fee for individuals aged 18 to 85.
Digital Platform: StAR NPS operationalised for Points of Presence (PoPs) to digitise NPS enrolment.
Fee & Eligibility: Registration fee fixed at ₹200 + tax for resident Indians aged 18 to 85 years.
Sandbox Net Worth: Non-registered sandbox applicants require ₹10 lakh minimum net worth.
StAR NPS age eligibility (18 to 85 years) vs registration fee (₹200).
